full_judgment: 6. In the instant case it is seen that the petitioner was tried by the Special Tribunal and he made the application under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure after the expiry of the period of limitation for appeal in other words the petitioner has sought to substitute his time barred appeal by an application u/s 561A of the Criminal Procedure Code. We have already held that in the garb of Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, a time barred appeal cannot be considered. But at the same time there is also a prayer for habeas corpus of the petitioner on the ground that he has been unlawfully detained and his detention in jail has not been made after proper trial i.e. the trial is without jurisdiction.
